summary: Phase 1 full-stack testing complete. Fixed 3 critical backend 500 errors (SQLAlchemy lazy loading in async context). All 17 backend tests pass. All 9 frontend pages load correctly. Login/dashboard/navigation all work.

critical.issue: SQLAlchemy MissingGreenlet error - lazy loading of Tenant.settings relationship inside Pydantic model_validate. FIXED by adding selectinload(Tenant.settings) to query.
Same SQLAlchemy lazy loading issue for TenantResponse.settings. FIXED by adding selectinload(Tenant.settings).
SQLAlchemy lazy loading of role.role_permissions and rp.permission. FIXED by adding selectinload(Role.role_permissions).selectinload(RolePermission.permission).

integration_issues.issue: Radix UI DropdownMenu logout item cannot be clicked in Playwright headless (known Radix/Playwright portal rendering issue). Logout API itself works correctly (confirmed via backend test). Manual testing would confirm UI logout works.

critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG PATTERN: Multiple SQLAlchemy async lazy-loading issues exist. Any endpoint that accesses relationships outside explicit async DB calls will fail. Recommend audit of all API endpoints that use model_validate with SQLAlchemy models having relationships. Use selectinload/joinedload consistently.
The /api/audit/ endpoint returns a paginated dict {items, total, page, page_size} not a list - frontend AuditLog page needs to handle this structure
The /api/users/ endpoint returns objects with nested 'user' field (TenantUser wrapper) not flat user objects - worth verifying the frontend handles this correctly

rca_of_issues: Root cause of 500 errors: SQLAlchemy 2.x async mode requires explicit eager loading. When Pydantic's model_validate accesses ORM relationship attributes (like tenant.settings, role.role_permissions), it triggers synchronous lazy SQL queries which fail with MissingGreenlet in async context. Fix: add selectinload() options to the SQLAlchemy select queries before model_validate is called.
